## Summary

Explain the change and why it is needed.

## Related issues, requirements, and decisions

Link relevant issues/requirement IDs. Cite approval for significant design choices.

## Validation

List actual commands, results, and manual/device checks. Identify unavailable,
skipped, or unverified checks explicitly; do not present them as passed.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read docs/CONTRIBUTING.md and kept this change focused.
- [ ] I updated relevant tests and documentation, or explained why not applicable.
- [ ] I checked for secrets/private data and have the right to contribute the material.
- [ ] I preserved reviewed content/corrections and considered draft exclusion.
- [ ] I considered accessibility, offline behavior, and language/script independence where relevant.

## Content, AI assistance, and remaining gaps

For content: identify source/permission, script review, and associated assets/settings.
For material AI assistance: describe the review and validation performed.
List unresolved risks or follow-up work; use "not applicable" where appropriate.
